title: (Sakkaccakārī-Sātaccakārī)
text: 1-7 Sāvatthi || || Samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī hoti na samādhismim sātaccakārī || || Samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī || || Neva samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī hoti na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī || || Samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī ca hoti samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī ca || || 8-9 Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ || pa || pa || uttamo ca pavaro cāti || ||
